title: Assert the worker TMPDIR in the live worker check
body: Outcome: npm run live:worker (scripts/live-worker.mjs) asserts that a real Codex turn sees TMPDIR, TMP and TEMP equal to <run>/tmp and can write there, so host Codex config drift (shell_environment_policy.set) is caught by a command that prints a verdict. Evidence: PR #181 root cause was ~/.codex/config.toml shell_environment_policy.set.TMPDIR overriding the app-server env; found only by a manual live probe (.krn/runs/lead/worker-tmpdir/rounds/001/report.json). Proof: live:worker exits non-zero when the turn reports a TMPDIR outside <run>/tmp.
